follow-up time: Until discharge from NICU or 14 days of life
cohort: 52 healthy term babies (>= 37 weeks) with non-hemolytic hyperbilirubinemia and a total serum bilirubin level of 20-25 mg/dL, admitted to the NICU.
finding: Fluid supplementation in addition to phototherapy had no significant effect on the rate of serum bilirubin reduction in healthy term breastfed neonates with severe hyperbilirubinemia.
